localChanges: A city's new name is now kept from later cities by the game's rules rather than by the page, so it holds however the city came to be renamed (closes #876).

log: A city's new name is now kept from later cities however the city came to be renamed, not only when you rename it yourself (civ-clone/web-renderer#876).
Renaming a city now tells the rules about it, so they can keep its new name from being given to another city (civ-clone/web-renderer#876).
